_comment: Synthetic. Fabricated merchants/amounts/dates/card numbers. This vector carries BOTH hazards at once: an 8-point row pitch under a 9-point font, tight enough that the platform's text layer joins adjacent rows into one string, AND a column-major draw order that splits every row across four of them. One pass has to split what was merged and join what was split. Header literals are the reader's own published claim markers from core/crates/kaname-core/src/statement/yes.rs.
